captions: Pilot Operations freezes the validated plan, then records per-device progress, blockers, assignment and due dates, actual effort, costs and evidence-backed manual checks.
A local scorecard distinguishes proposed devices from technician-reported outcomes. Export a handoff or backup. These records neither consume shared stock nor certify a physical release.

captions: A public model question invokes Tavily in the application backend. The server filters official documentation, assigns source IDs, and passes only bounded snippets to NVIDIA Nemotron on Nebius.
The result shows its sources, uncertainties and next checks. A matched citation is not a hardware diagnosis: the technician must inspect the source and the actual device.

captions: Nano and Lightning can investigate. Super writes and freshly reviews non-Ultra cases. Ultra is an explicit operator-enabled escalation, not an automatic promise of better quality.

name: Real provider usage, with limits
title: Four tiers appear in recorded usage.
detail: Usage confirms requests. It does not establish accuracy, value or per-change economics.

captions: The supplied usage view records all four tiers. Its rounded cost buckets are provider evidence, not an exact invoice or comparative benchmark.

name: What the AI harness controls
title: The model reasons. Trusted code authorizes.
detail: Each transition has an explicit input, output and check.
label: Implemented architecture diagram · No unrestricted agent execution
captions: The harness bounds evidence, requires structured output, and validates changes. The model has no shell, network, or publishing tool.
Trusted server code controls testing and publication. The model proposes; the application authorizes each transition.

name: Bound the stage before it starts

detail: Guardrails constrain execution; they do not guarantee the model is correct.

captions: A model stage has a forty-second deadline, a bounded context, strict output and reserved spend. There is no automatic paid retry after an uncertain result.

Evidence revision and hash
Verification tied to that candidate
label: Actual generated patch · Default branch unchanged
captions: Evidence revision, repository commit and candidate hashes travel together. Changed inputs require fresh verification and approval; a passing test cannot bless another patch.

name: Reproduce, then verify the same tests
title:
First, it fails.
Then, the same
tests pass.
detail:
Original: 1 failed, 3 passed.
Candidate: 4 passed, 0 failed.
The tests stayed unchanged.
label: Actual test result · Network-disabled execution container
captions: GitHub Actions executes both versions in a network-disabled container. The original has one failure and three passes.
The candidate passes all four unchanged test cases. That proves covered behavior, not every input or hardware condition.
